description: An arithmetic structure is a full model of the second-order Peano theory exactly when it satisfies Robinson arithmetic and induction for every subset of its domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.models_peano_iff.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.FullModels M
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.peanoTheory ↔
    M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.Q ∧ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.FullSubsetInduction M
